articles.availability_note: October 23 NIH release and PNAS abstract describe a 1972 policy. Regression discontinuity supports the authors’ causal argument under assumptions, not random assignment. Selected UK Biobank cohort, diagnoses before December 2022, oldest age 65: not lifetime prevention, a cure or an adult-learning prescription. The release’s 14% concerns staying at school; a percentage-point conversion is not verified. The ambiguous .88% effect magnitude was excluded from the brief. Mechanisms and generalisability remain open. Full paper unavailable in this check.

NASA’s October 23 plans, not a completed flight or independent readiness certification. The 2027 Earth-orbit and 2028 landing dates remain targets. Four astronauts and about 14 days are planned; about two days inside Blue Moon and up to two hours of Starship docking concern different phases. Crew would not enter Starship. Three spacecraft and launch vehicles, health checks and software/coordination exercises are planned tests, not proven risk reduction. Strategic judgments are analysis. Illustration is imagined models, not exact hardware or a flight photograph.
